blocks.text:
There are two ways to create a Button. You can specify a label
string in the `Gtk::Button` constructor,
or set it later with set_label().
blocks.zh: 创建 `Gtk::Button` 有两种方式：可以在构造函数中直接传入标签文字，也可以之后再调用 set_label() 设置。

blocks.text: To define an accelerator key for keyboard navigation, place an underscore before one of the label's characters and specify `true` for the optional `mnemonic` parameter. For instance:
blocks.zh: 若要为键盘导航定义快捷键（助记符），在标签字符前放一个下划线，并调用 set_use_underline(true)——例如「_开」配合 Alt 快捷键。

blocks.text:
`Gtk::Button` is also
a container so you could put any other widget, such as a
`Gtk::Image` into it.
blocks.zh: `Gtk::Button` 本身也是一个容器，因此可以把任意其他控件放进按钮里——比如一个 `Gtk::Image`。

blocks.text:
The `Gtk::Button` widget has the `clicked` signal
which is emitted when the button is pressed and released.
blocks.zh: `Gtk::Button` 控件拥有 `clicked` 信号，在按钮被按下并释放之后发出。
